auditedPrs.notes: Re-audit of squash commit 041861c on main. The diff ports no Go. It removes `no-std` from the crates.io categories of ts_netstack_smoltcp, ts_netstack_smoltcp_core and ts_netstack_smoltcp_socket, because their command channel `flume` needs std. It adds comments above the unchanged `#![no_std]` attributes, a 'Platform support' README section, and a `no_std_honest` check in the `checks` crate. No runtime code, default, error path or platform gate changes. Compared against github.com/tailscale/tailscale at e2ed432399c9b0fda7aa14e9eb27784d2d893c55, the pin in PORTING.md, fetched with depth 1. Upstream's netstack is wgengine/netstack, built on gVisor in Go. Its platform splits (netstack_linux.go, netstack_tcpbuf_ios.go, netstack_userping_apple.go) are OS gates, not a std/no-std split, and the PR does not touch them. `grep -rIl -E 'no_std|no-std|flume' --include='*.go'` over the tree returns nothing. The PR has no upstream counterpart to diverge from, so there are no findings. This agrees with the earlier audit of the same PR (#570).

gate.detail: Ran the scoped gate stages on main 8b1d742 with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4, RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 and TS_RS_EXPERIMENT set. All green: cargo run -p checks; cargo clippy --workspace --exclude ts_cli_util --lib --no-deps --all-features -- -D warnings; the same clippy over bins/tests/benches/examples with -D warnings -A missing_docs; cargo nextest run -p geiserx_ts_control -p geiserx_ts_runtime --all-features --no-fail-fast, 986 run and 986 green in 71s, with 3 skipped; cargo build --workspace --exclude ts_cli_util --all-targets --all-features. The 3 skipped tests were filtered out on purpose because they need sockets this environment blocks: serve_path_proxy_replays_consumed_head_to_backend and proxy_with_prefix_writes_prefix_before_bidi_copy hang on a dropped loopback SYN, and probe_stun_servers_once_sends_binding_request needs outbound UDP. The full bin/check was not run. ts_cli_util's tracy feature does not compile under --all-features, and cargo deny check all refuses aws-lc-rs/aws-lc-sys on every branch, so the set -e script stops before nextest.
